onboarding.title: Have you worked with scientific data before?
onboarding.subtitle: This lets us adapt the tool to you. You can change it any time.
onboarding.newDesc: A few short questions, plus step-by-step examples you can watch.
onboarding.expertDesc: Go straight to the tool: region, period, variables and analysis.
onboarding.voiceHint: You can also say: “I'm new” or “I have experience”.
onboarding.notUnderstood: I did not catch that. Pick an option, or say “I'm new” or “I have experience”.
onboarding.spoken: Have you worked with scientific data before? Say I'm new, or I have experience.

guided.introTitle: Let's investigate a place on the planet
guided.introDesc: Answer three short questions, by voice or with a click, and we will find the NASA data that best shows change.
guided.spokenIntro: Let's investigate a place on the planet. Answer three short questions, or watch an example.
guided.q1: What do you want to investigate?
guided.q1Hint: Pick a topic or say it: rain, heat, plants or soil.
guided.q2Hint: Say or type a place. You can also pick one from the list.
guided.q3: Which period do you want to look at?
guided.q3Hint: More years give more evidence. Say five, ten, or historical.
guided.regionNotFound: I did not recognise that place. Try a country, region or landform.
guided.topicNotUnderstood: I did not catch the topic. Pick an option.
guided.periodNotUnderstood: I did not catch the period. Pick an option.
guided.suggestIntro: Ranked by their potential to reveal a trend in this place. Remove any you do not want.
guided.limits: A match between variables describes a relationship; it does not prove which caused which.
guided.spokenQ1: What do you want to investigate? Rain, heat, plants or soil water.
guided.spokenQ2: Where? Say a place, for example the Amazon.
guided.spokenQ3: Which period do you want? Five years, ten, or the full record.
guided.spokenSuggest: These are the variables with the most potential to show change.

demo.label: Example
demo.done: That's it. Now it's your turn.
demo.note: Analysis values in this example are illustrative.

regionStep.title: Study region
regionStep.description: Type or say the area you want to investigate.
regionStep.hint: With the microphone you can say “Amazon Basin” or “Nicaragua”.
regionStep.notFound: I did not recognise that place. Try another name.

periodStep.title: Period
periodStep.description: Trends need several years to separate the seasonal cycle from real change.

variablesStep.title: Variables
variablesStep.description: Choose what to measure. Each is analysed separately, then compared.

resultsStep.title: Results
resultsStep.description: Linear trend per variable, with confidence interval and multiple-test adjustment.
resultsStep.illustrative: Illustrative values from the project guide; not yet computed from real data.
resultsStep.sent: Polygon and parameters sent to the backend.
resultsStep.sendFailed: The backend did not respond. Start the server at {url}.
resultsStep.limits: A match between variables does not prove cause. Relevant is not the same as significant.
